title: VSP
description: A resource pack that adds modded shader features to the vanilla game.
body:
A resource pack that adds common modded shader features to the vanilla game, including:
- Screen-space AO
- Shadow mapping
- Volumetric fog
- Atmospheric scattering
- Bloom
- Screen-space reflections
- PBR material support: smoothness, normal mapping, ao, emissiveness, reflectance, sss, generic metals.
- Temporal AA
- Directional lightmaps
- Water waves

Includes a slightly modified and converted version of [Vanilla Normals Renewed](https://github.com/Poudingue/Vanilla-Normals-Renewed) for PBR.

**Vanilla 1.21.4 and *Fabulous!* graphics are required.**
